mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 2.0% (p-value > 0.05 for positive return rate).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% for three consecutive months signals labor market deterioration, triggering corporate earnings contraction and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 4.0% in 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 4.0% for three months, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases (p-value > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad consumer demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: When HOUST and RSAFS both decline, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances (p-value > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth exceeding 105.0 (year-over-year) signals easing supply constraints, expanding corporate margins and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO exceeds 105.0, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods (p-value > 0.05 for positive return rate).

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales growth above its 12-month moving average indicates robust consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS exceeds its 12-month moving average, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases (p-value > 0.05 for positive return rate).

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% annually signals accelerating price pressures, prompting aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL annual inflation exceeds 3.5%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances (p-value > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market contraction, reducing consumer spending and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases (p-value > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, positive retail sales growth (RSAFS) signals sustained consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings support equity valuations.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, when RSAFS grows, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases (p-value > 0.05 for positive return rate).
